description:
Target A item A-4 (docs/v2-endgame-plan.md §6; catalogue §8 + §11.7). The transpiled pack oracle re-parses the template string EVERY call (bench pack ~1180×); p-sprintf re-parses its format each call (~5×: sp0 0.129s vs sp1 0.025s @ 200k). Fix: (1) memoize template parse keyed on the template string inside the oracle/runtime (helps dynamic call sites too); (2) for a LITERAL template/format, hoist the parse to load-time-value and call a plan-driven formatter (p-sprintf-compiled / specialized packer). Same pattern for constant join separators and constant regex scanners (catalogue §8). Independent of E2–E5; scoreboard = bench-exec pack/packunpk rows.

USER RULING (2026-08-29, s450): the PACK half WAITS ON PCLXS -- if the bridge proves out, the plan is to take perl-s existing C implementation (pp_pack.c) and package it as an XS module through pclxs, instead of optimizing the transpiled cl/pcl-pack.lisp oracle.  Do NOT start pack-oracle memoization/optimization work.  The SPRINTF half (constant-format pre-compiled formatter, measured ~5x, no XS story -- sprintf is core language, not a module) remains in scope as its own smaller item.  MEASURED s455c (Fable, 2026-08-30, sb-sprof steady-state after warming the lazy extension compile): the PREMISE "re-parses the template every call" is WRONG for pack -- there is NO separated parse to memoize (_pack_tmpl/_unpack_tmpl walk the template WHILE packing), and the profile is FLAT: %make-p-box 14%, p-find-overload 14% (-> #815), box-set 6%, p-get-class+%p-target-class 6%, %p-flatten-list 8%, p-substr 5% -- ~21us per bench call-pair vs perl ~0.17us, death-by-boxed-interpreter.  So the in-PCL fix is a PLAN/EXECUTOR RESTRUCTURE of pack-impl (parse once -> compact op list; raw-CL executor), a real session, NOT the filler the catalogue suggested; the USER-ruled pclxs/pp_pack.c route STANDS as the plan (USER asked s455c "if it is just a memoization of a sub" -- it is not, so the s450 ruling is unchanged).  The sprintf half: p-sprintf (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp:4474) is ALSO fused, native CL -- a contained plan/executor refactor of one function, bigger than a filler, smaller than pack.
subject: Perf P1: pack/sprintf constant-template memoization (oracle rows / ~5×)
